pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The "ch" in "Nacht" is pronounced: (1 mark)
   A. like sh in ship
   B. like ch in chair
   C. like k in kite
   D. as a breathy sound at the back of the mouth

2. What does "die Familie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. grandfather
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. family
   D. father

3. Which noun goes with "meine"? (1 mark)
   A. Vater
   B. Mutter
   C. Onkel
   D. Bruder

4. Which sentence means "This is my sister"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist meine Schwester.
   B. Das ist meine Bruder.
   C. Das ist mein Vater.
   D. Das ist mein Schwester.

5. Why do we copy the teacher's sounds when learning German? (1 mark)
   A. To avoid reading
   B. To learn the sounds accurately by practice
   C. To learn only spelling
   D. To make the class noisy

6. Which day is between Montag and Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Dienstag
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Samstag
   D. Freitag

7. In "Geburtstag", how do you say the letter "u"? (1 mark)
   A. like uh
   B. like yoo
   C. like ow
   D. like oo

8. How is the letter ö made? (1 mark)
   A. Say ay with round lips
   B. Say oh with wide lips
   C. Say ee with wide lips
   D. Say ow

9. How is the letter B named in German? (1 mark)
   A. bay
   B. day
   C. tsay
   D. ay

10. Which German word must begin with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. ist
   B. und
   C. Mutter
   D. nett

11. What does "stark" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. old
   B. small
   C. hard-working
   D. strong

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Donnerstag"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

13. Which German word is the number 15? (1 mark)
   A. eins
   B. neunzehn
   C. null
   D. fünfzehn

14. What does "das Geschenk" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. present
   B. birthday
   C. balloon
   D. candle

15. Which German word is the number 13? (1 mark)
   A. eins
   B. dreizehn
   C. zwölf
   D. vier

16. Which German word or phrase means "How are you?"? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Guten Tag
   C. Wie geht's?
   D. Ja

17. What is the plural of "der Vater"? (1 mark)
   A. die Vaters
   B. die Väter
   C. die Vateren
   D. die Vatere

18. Which German word or phrase means "uncle"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eltern
   B. der Bruder
   C. der Onkel
   D. die Familie

19. What does "lustig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. young
   B. funny
   C. hard-working
   D. old

20. Which sentence is spelled and written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. am Freitag singe ich
   B. Am Freitak singe ich.
   C. Am Freitag singe ich.
   D. Am Freitag ich singe.

21. Which German word means "November"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Mai
   B. März
   C. November
   D. September

22. Which German word means "January"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. März
   B. Juli
   C. Januar
   D. November

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Party"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

24. Which food group does "die Milch" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Obst

25. Which German word or phrase means "onion"? (1 mark)
   A. der Saft
   B. die Karotte
   C. die Zwiebel
   D. die Milch

26. Which little word goes with the noun "Kakao"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

27. Which German word or phrase means "finger"? (1 mark)
   A. der Finger
   B. das Ohr
   C. der Kopf
   D. das Bein

28. What does "Das sind meine Augen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my eye
   B. These are my eyes
   C. These are my ears
   D. That is my nose

29. Which little word goes with the noun "Bauch"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. das
   D. den

30. Which weather sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Heute regnet es.
   B. Es heute regnet.
   C. Regnet heute es
   D. Heute es regnet.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother. (4 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana. (3 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa. (4 marks)

34. Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye. (4 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese. (5 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat. (3 marks)

37. Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch". (2 marks)

38. Unscramble the letters TAGFIRE to make a day of the week. (2 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker. (2 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall. (2 marks)

41. Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno" (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth. (2 marks)

44. Describe a floor plan of your dream house in German. Name at least three rooms. (3 marks)

45. Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write. (2 marks)

46. Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name. (2 marks)

47. Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural. (2 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — as a breathy sound at the back of the mouth
   After a, o and u the ch is a scratchy breath sound at the back of the mouth.

2. C — family
   die Familie means family.

3. B — Mutter
   Mutter is a die word, so we say meine Mutter.

4. A — Das ist meine Schwester.
   Schwester is a die word, so we say meine.

5. B — To learn the sounds accurately by practice
   Imitation trains the ears and mouth to make the new sounds.

6. A — Dienstag
   The order is Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch.

7. D — like oo
   The u in Geburtstag is said oo.

8. A — Say ay with round lips
   ö is made with the lips rounded.

9. A — bay
   In German the letter B is called bay.

10. C — Mutter
   German nouns always begin with a capital letter.

11. D — strong
   stark means strong.

12. A — der
   It is der Donnerstag, so the little word is der.

13. D — fünfzehn
   15 in German is fünfzehn.

14. A — present
   das Geschenk means present.

15. B — dreizehn
   13 in German is dreizehn.

16. C — Wie geht's?
   How are you? in German is Wie geht's?.

17. B — die Väter
   The plural of der Vater is die Väter.

18. C — der Onkel
   uncle in German is der Onkel.

19. B — funny
   lustig means funny.

20. C — Am Freitag singe ich.
   Capital letters for Am and Freitag, correct spelling and a full stop.

21. C — November
   November in German is November.

22. C — Januar
   January in German is Januar.

23. C — die
   It is die Party, so the little word is die.

24. C — die Getränke
   die Milch belongs to die Getränke.

25. C — die Zwiebel
   onion in German is die Zwiebel.

26. A — der
   It is der Kakao, so the little word is der.

27. A — der Finger
   finger in German is der Finger.

28. B — These are my eyes
   sind is used for more than one thing.

29. A — der
   It is der Bauch, so the little word is der.

30. A — Heute regnet es.
   regnet is the second word.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Freitag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the capital letter.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das ist die Küche. Das ist das Wohnzimmer. Das ist das Schlafzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each room correctly named.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Mund, die Tür.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
